tower.berthaWhat: Clears a cross of five wall blocks, and fires first whenever it is ready. Its shell flies as fast as a cannon's.
tower.berthaFastWhat: Clears a cross of five wall blocks, and fires first whenever it is ready. Its shell flies faster than a cannon's, so it reloads sooner.
tower.berthaSlowWhat: Clears a cross of five wall blocks, and fires first whenever it is ready. Its shell flies slower than a cannon's, so it reloads later.

tower.architectWhat.one: Rebuilds your walls lost in a circle {n} block across around it once each barrage is over.
tower.architectWhat.other: Rebuilds your walls lost in a circle {n} blocks across around it once each barrage is over.

tower.rapidWhat: {n} cannons stacked in one cannon's place, each with its own reload.
tower.lightningWhat: Strikes at once, then jumps {n} times to walls within {r} blocks — fires first whenever it is ready.
tower.biggestWhat: One enormous shell each combat phase: it flies {s} seconds, near or far, and clears every wall block in a circle of {n} tiles where it lands — fires first whenever it is ready.
tower.laserWhat: Fires a beam on the instant through the first {n} wall blocks in its line, however far — fires first whenever it is ready.
tower.laserChanceWhat: Fires a beam on the instant through the first {n} wall blocks in its line, however far, and one more {p}% of the time — fires first whenever it is ready.
tower.frostWhat: Freezes the tile it hits for the whole next build phase, overtime too: nothing can be built there — fires first whenever it is ready.
tower.frostClockWhat: Freezes the tile it hits for the next build phase until its clock runs out: nothing can be built there — fires first whenever it is ready.
tower.frostShareWhat: Freezes the tile it hits for the first {p}% of the next build phase: nothing can be built there until it thaws — fires first whenever it is ready.
tower.lullabyWhat: Its shot lulls the {n} enemy guns nearest the tile it hits, within {r} blocks: a cannon falls asleep for {s} seconds at once, a special tower after {t} lullabies; an Architect as a cannon; the Allerdickste Bertha never sleeps — fires first whenever it is ready.
tower.lullabyAnyWhat: Its shot lulls the {n} enemy guns nearest the tile it hits: a cannon falls asleep for {s} seconds at once, a special tower after {t} lullabies; an Architect as a cannon; the Allerdickste Bertha never sleeps — fires first whenever it is ready.
